--- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [Graph.edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | EdgeCase description: Calculate current-flow (random-walk) betweenness for all edges. twitter-card: title: >- [Graph.edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | EdgeCase description: Calculate current-flow (random-walk) betweenness for all edges. title: >- [Graph.edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: >- Calculate current-flow (random-walk) betweenness for all edges. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Calculate current-flow (random-walk) betweenness for all edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L53005-L53144){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature Graph.edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality( normalized=True, weighted=None, attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Edge current-flow betweenness centrality](../assets/graphs/edge-current-flow-betweenness-centrality.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The shared seven-node graph with each edge drawn thicker the more electrical current it carries when every pair of nodes in turn sends a unit of current. The bridge E-F carries the most, 0.33 in accent, then C-E 0.23, D-E 0.22 and F-G 0.20; the triangle edges B-C and C-D, with parallel routes beside them, carry the least, 0.12." width="100%"} This is the edge counterpart of `current_flow_betweenness_centrality()`. The graph is treated as an electrical network: for every pair of nodes, one unit of current enters at one and leaves at the other, spreading over all paths in proportion to their conductance, and an edge scores the total current it carries. Equivalently, it measures how often random walks between pairs cross the edge. Where `edge_betweenness_centrality()` only credits edges on shortest paths, this measure also credits edges on detours, so it suits flows that are not optimally routed (power grids, diffusion, gossip). Edge weights act as conductances. Self-loops carry no current and score `0`; parallel edges split the current between them. The graph must be undirected and connected. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [normalized]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True` (default), divide the total current by `(n - 1)(n - 2)`. If `False`, return half the total current over all pairs. Both match NetworkX's `edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality()`. [weighted]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to use edge weights as conductances. If `None` (default), follows the graph. Weights must be positive. [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the edge attribute to store scores in. If `None` (default), uses `"edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality"`. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns a dictionary instead of self. If `False` (default), stores the scores as an edge attribute and returns self for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, float], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `return_dict=` is `True`: a dictionary mapping edge IDs to scores. If `return_dict=` is `False` (default): returns self. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is directed or disconnected, or a weight is not positive. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} After one inversion of the grounded Laplacian ($O(V^3)$), each edge's currents for all pairs follow from one row of potential differences, summed over pairs in $O(V \log V)$ by sorting (Brandes & Fleischer, 2005). ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~current_flow_betweenness_centrality`) : The same measure for nodes. [](`~edge_betweenness_centrality`) : Count shortest paths only. [](`~edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality_subset`) : Count chosen pairs only. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Two triangles joined by a bridge: every unit of current between the triangles must cross the bridge, while inside each triangle current splits over both routes: ::: {#0a06b0c5 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph.from_edges( [("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "A"), ("C", "D"), ("D", "E"), ("E", "F"), ("F", "D")] ) ( graph.edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality() .get_edge_df(labels=True) .select("source", "target", "edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality") .sort("edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality", descending=True) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}

But the edge from member 1 to member 30 is fifth by current flow and thirtieth by betweenness: it's on few shortest routes, but on many that are nearly as short: ::: {#50773159 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl club = ( ec.karate_club() .layout_kamada_kawai() .edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality() .edge_betweenness_centrality() ) ( club.get_edge_df(labels=True) .with_columns( pl.col( "edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality", "edge_betweenness_centrality", ) .rank("min", descending=True) .name.suffix("_rank") ) .select( "source", "target", "edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality_rank", "edge_betweenness_centrality_rank", ) .sort("edge_current_flow_betweenness_centrality_rank") .head(5) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
